# Findings (generated by `python -m email_uplift.report`)

Every number below is produced by the code in this repo; re-running the report regenerates this file.

## 2. Did the emails work?

Holm-adjusted p-values cover all nine comparisons below.

| comparison | metric | rates | lift | 95% CI | relative lift | p (Holm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Men's email vs No email | visit | 18.28% vs 10.62% | +7.66 pp | 7.00 to 8.32 pp | 72.1% | 5.1e-111 |
| Men's email vs No email | conversion | 1.25% vs 0.57% | +0.68 pp | 0.50 to 0.86 pp | 118.8% | 9.1e-13 |
| Men's email vs No email | spend | $1.423 vs $0.653 | +$0.770 | $0.485 to $1.055 | 117.9% | 5.8e-07 |
| Women's email vs No email | visit | 15.14% vs 10.62% | +4.52 pp | 3.89 to 5.16 pp | 42.6% | 2.5e-43 |
| Women's email vs No email | conversion | 0.88% vs 0.57% | +0.31 pp | 0.15 to 0.47 pp | 54.3% | 0.00063 |
| Women's email vs No email | spend | $1.077 vs $0.653 | +$0.424 | $0.169 to $0.680 | 65.0% | 0.0023 |
| Men's email vs Women's email | visit | 18.28% vs 15.14% | +3.14 pp | 2.43 to 3.84 pp | 20.7% | 2.7e-17 |
| Men's email vs Women's email | conversion | 1.25% vs 0.88% | +0.37 pp | 0.17 to 0.56 pp | 41.8% | 0.00063 |
| Men's email vs Women's email | spend | $1.423 vs $1.077 | +$0.345 | $0.033 to $0.658 | 32.1% | 0.03 |

Minimum detectable conversion lift at 80% power for one email vs no email: 0.20 pp.

## 4–5. Targeting: who to email with half the budget

Primary model: **T-learner, logistic, conversion** (pre-specified). Scores are 5-fold cross-fitted. Each ranking is evaluated on how much incremental spend the top 50% delivers versus a random 50%, for the same email. Dollars are for the 64,000-customer list over the two-week window; intervals are bootstrap 95%.

| ranking | email | top-50% incremental spend | random-50% | extra vs random (95% CI) | share of full-campaign spend lift | share of full-campaign extra purchases |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-learner, logistic, conversion | Men's email | $23,738 | $24,634 | $-897 (-10,276 to 8,579) | 48.2% | 45.3% |
| T-learner, logistic, conversion | Women's email | $20,315 | $13,581 | $6,734 (-1,449 to 15,159) | 74.8% | 84.5% |
| T-learner, boosting, conversion | Men's email | $19,857 | $24,634 | $-4,778 (-13,926 to 4,860) | 40.3% | 43.6% |
| T-learner, boosting, conversion | Women's email | $19,153 | $13,581 | $5,572 (-2,413 to 13,314) | 70.5% | 76.8% |
| T-learner, logistic, visit | Men's email | $22,443 | $24,634 | $-2,191 (-11,479 to 6,773) | 45.6% | 43.9% |
| T-learner, logistic, visit | Women's email | $19,416 | $13,581 | $5,835 (-1,876 to 13,397) | 71.5% | 85.6% |
| T-learner, boosting, visit | Men's email | $20,086 | $24,634 | $-4,549 (-13,964 to 4,633) | 40.8% | 40.0% |
| T-learner, boosting, visit | Women's email | $17,001 | $13,581 | $3,420 (-4,678 to 11,402) | 62.6% | 78.9% |
